name: Jira tickets by mapped company (v12 - reload)

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  TRIM(company_name) AS company_name,
  TRIM(CAST(company_id AS TEXT)) AS company_id
FROM uk_clientco_test.jira_company_mapping
WHERE company_id IS NOT NULL
  AND company_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(company_name) <> ''
ORDER BY 1;
